caption: The drawing depicts a wooden object resembling a manual grinder or mechanical device mounted on a stand. The upper part consists of a rectangular box with a hinged lid and trapezoidal side panels secured with visible dovetail joints. A metal crank handle with a black shaft extends outward from a central point on the front face of the box. The box is supported by two ornately cut vertical side supports, which have curved inner edges and are attached to a lower rectangular base, also made from wood. The wooden components are varying shades of brown, showing wood grain patterns throughout. The entire structure stands on a flat surface, and the overall composition is centered with a neutral, light beige background. The name "EVA PERRY" is printed in small, capital letters at the lower right corner of the image.
title: Dough Mixer
